method: Live OpenLigaDB, GBGB JSON, OpenDota fetches plus previously verified SportScore widget keys. ESPN site.api returned 403 from this workstation; ESPN mapping still uses previously captured scoreboard shapes. UNKNOWN is not treated as unavailable.

fields.period_quarter_set: AVAILABLE + STORED (HT/FT/ET/PEN from matchResults; promoted onto canonical keepers)
fields.clock: NOT AVAILABLE (no match minute on this endpoint)
fields.explicit_live_status: NOT AVAILABLE — LIVE only from goals or in-progress matchResults, never elapsed kickoff
fields.venue: AVAILABLE + STORED when location.locationStadium present (often null)
fields.standings: SECONDARY — getbltable already scheduled as standings
fields.winner: NOT AVAILABLE as named winner (score only)

fields.score: AVAILABLE + STORED (home/away only; tennis live often 0-0 with no sets)
fields.period_quarter_set: NOT AVAILABLE on widget JSON (verified keys: home, away, scores, status, time, competition, url, logos)
fields.explicit_live_status: AVAILABLE when widget status is live/inplay
fields.match_html: UNKNOWN — NEEDS INVESTIGATION (not enabled; would be extra HTML per match)

rows.endpoint: espn scoreboard JSON/HTML already used by list ingest
rows.note: Railway scoreboard path is ACCESS_BLOCKED, not SUPPORTED. Adapter retained with family backoff. Do not probe while blocked; do not bypass/proxy/CAPTCHA.

fields.clock: AVAILABLE + STORED (status.displayClock); omitted from public live payload if observation >180s stale
fields.explicit_live_status: AVAILABLE when ACCESS is not blocked
fields.hits_errors: AVAILABLE + STORED on baseball score.hits/errors when present

fields.period_quarter_set: AVAILABLE + STORED (ScoreSetNA/B individual sets; no inference from match score)
fields.explicit_live_status: AVAILABLE from match status when supplied
fields.surface: AVAILABLE + STORED when calendar supplies surface
fields.category: AVAILABLE + STORED when calendar supplies level

fields.runners: AVAILABLE + STORED (grouped by raceId: trap, name, trainer, position)
fields.time_margin: NOT AVAILABLE on inspected items (no runTime/margin keys)
